theorem majVote_facts (r : w8) (s q q' : GSet w64) (Hr : r = VoteWon ∨ r = VoteLost ∨ r =
    VotePending) (Hemp : s = ∅ → r = VoteWon) (Hw : s ≠ ∅ → (r = VoteWon ↔ IsQuorum s q)) (Hl : s ≠
    ∅ → (r = VoteLost ↔ ¬IsQuorum s q')) : (r = VoteWon ↔ MajQ s q) ∧ (r = VoteLost ↔ ¬MajQ s q')

theorem jointVote_facts (r1 r2 : w8) (Hr1 : r1 = VoteWon ∨ r1 = VoteLost ∨ r1 = VotePending) (Hr2 :
    r2 = VoteWon ∨ r2 = VoteLost ∨ r2 = VotePending) : have res := if r1 = r2 then r1 else if r1 =
    VoteLost ∨ r2 = VoteLost then VoteLost else VotePending; (res = VoteWon ∨ res = VoteLost ∨ res =
    VotePending) ∧ (res = VoteWon ↔ r1 = VoteWon ∧ r2 = VoteWon) ∧ (res = VoteLost ↔ r1 = VoteLost ∨
    r2 = VoteLost)
